title: No wrong probability-of-ruin estimate, no orphan causal-inference module, one shared exchange stress formula
statement: RiskQuantifier has no estimate_probability_of_ruin method and src/intelligence/causal_inference.py does not exist, because neither had a caller and the ruin estimate was wrong. The Binance, OKX and Bybit providers compute exchange_stress_score through the single base.exchange_stress_score function, whose weights sum to 1 and whose basis, funding and OI-drop components saturate at 100 bps, 3 sigma and -5%.
failure_mode: estimate_probability_of_ruin set u to the 90th percentile of daily returns and counted every day below it as an excess, so about 90% of days fed the 'GPD' term, which was not a GPD fit; its empirical term looked for a single day below -50% and never measured a drawdown. It was uncalled, so the only control was its own tests, which asserted only that the output lay in [0, 1]. causal_inference.py had no importer and a hardcoded _predict_sharpe demo, yet kept tests and a model-safety entry alive. The stress formula was copied into three providers, so a change to one venue would silently diverge from the others. The deciding test now fails if either removed item returns or a provider stops using the shared formula.
